info.title: wow-migrate
info.description: Web-free SQL migrator CLI (`wow-migrate`) over the WoW Two be sdk bespoke migrator — the image's migrate verb tree (check, plan, apply, seed, sets, rollback, forget, repair, baseline, claim, locks, unlock) plus new and promote, against a Postgres database, for one migration set or every set in a --sets manifest.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: wow-migrate — the migrate verb tree over a manifest of sets, plus the authoring verbs new and promote.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --connection
options.description: Postgres connection (else WOW_MIGRATE_DB_CONNECTION, else localhost/postgres).

options.name: --sql-dir
options.description: Migrations dir of a single set (else WOW_MIGRATE_SQL_DIR, else auto-discovered).

options.name: --sets
options.description: Migration-sets manifest (JSON) listing every set (else WOW_MIGRATE_SETS); verbs run all of them unless --set picks one.

options.name: --schema
options.description: Schema of a single set: holds its history and fills {{schema}} (else 'public').

options.name: --schema-owner
options.description: Claim the single set's schema under this owner; creates the schema and refuses one claimed by another owner.

options.name: --owner-instance
options.description: The instance the single set's schema is claimed as (required with --schema-owner): the host's Migrations:OwnerInstance, else {applicationName}@{DEPLOY_ENVIRONMENT}.

options.name: --set
options.description: Run one set by name; without it every set. A writing operator verb needs it when the host has several sets.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the verb's JSON report on stdout before the migrate-result line, instead of the human report on stderr. [default: False]

commands.name: check
commands.description: Compare each set with this image, read-only: 0 when it may run (current, or a compatible ahead), else 1.

commands.name: plan
commands.description: List each set's pending migrations with their kinds; takes no lock and writes nothing.

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Create the database when missing, then apply every set's pending migrations in dependency order.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Rehearse the pending migrations in one transaction and roll back; never creates the database. [default: False]

commands.name: seed
commands.description: Apply every set's seed files not yet journalled, after apply.

commands.name: sets
commands.description: Describe every set this image carries — level, contracts, dependencies, extensions, package — without settings or a database.

commands.name: rollback
commands.description: Run Rollback.sql newest first down to --to N and delete their rows; one set, confirmed.

options.name: --to
options.description: The level to roll back to.

options.name: --confirm
options.description: The name of the database this verb writes to; it must match the database the set connects to.

commands.name: forget
commands.description: Delete history rows above --above N without running SQL; one set, confirmed.

options.name: --above
options.description: The level to keep; rows above it are forgotten.

options.name: --include-contracts
options.description: Forget a contract or a row with no kind too. [default: False]

options.name: --confirm
options.description: The name of the database this verb writes to; it must match the database the set connects to.

commands.name: repair
commands.description: Re-record drifted checksums; one set, confirmed.

options.name: --confirm
options.description: The name of the database this verb writes to; it must match the database the set connects to.

commands.name: baseline
commands.description: Record migrations as applied without running them, so an existing database adopts the set; one set, confirmed.

options.name: --to
options.description: The last ordinal to record as applied; every source migration without it.

options.name: --confirm
options.description: The name of the database this verb writes to; it must match the database the set connects to.

commands.name: claim
commands.description: Record the set's schema marker under an owner and instance, replacing any marker; one set, confirmed.

options.name: --owner
options.description: The owner kind, such as module or service.

options.name: --instance
options.description: The instance, such as identity-haven@prod.

options.name: --confirm
options.description: The name of the database this verb writes to; it must match the database the set connects to.

commands.name: locks
commands.description: List the sessions holding each set's migrator locks, read-only.

commands.name: unlock
commands.description: End every session holding the set's migrator locks; one set, confirmed.

options.name: --confirm
options.description: The name of the database this verb writes to; it must match the database the set connects to.

commands.name: bg
commands.description: Control background migrations — pause, resume, retry, rollback; refused until they ship.
